title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Reinstatement Expense Payment
content:
Under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, a borrower who reinstates the contract after repossession pays the case's recovery expenses through the borrower's own reinstatement expense payment. This entry governs that payment.

**Settlement of expenses.** Recovery expenses on a case in recovered status are also settled by the borrower's own redemption expense payment or by the borrower's own reinstatement expense payment, each as its own rule sets out; every other settlement of recovery expenses is made only when the case is reinstated, redeemed or sold.

**Reinstatement portions.** The contract portion of a reinstatement posts to the contract as a reinstatement payment, and the case's recovery expenses are settled by the borrower's own reinstatement expense payment, paid in person through a certified payment channel and figured by this rule through the payment date in place of the expense portion a reinstatement quote states; a reinstatement quote keeps stating the case's recovery expenses outstanding through its good-through date including storage accrued to it at the class storage fee per day.

**Storage.** Storage covered by a borrower's own redemption expense payment or reinstatement expense payment is settled by that payment and is never posted for those days; all other storage is posted once, on the date the vehicle is released or sold, for every chargeable day up to that date that no such payment covered.

Storage that the borrower's own reinstatement expense payment covers is charged as this rule sets out, and storage that the borrower's own redemption expense payment covers is charged by its own redemption expense payment rule; storage posted on release or sale, and storage in the expenses a reinstatement quote states, is charged at the class storage fee per day for each chargeable day (the chargeable storage days, recorded as the days charged).

**When the payment is fixed.** On a case whose vehicle the borrower surrendered voluntarily, the reinstatement expense payment is fixed only after the voluntary surrender fee stands posted on the case.

## Taking the payment

| Item | Contract |
|---|---|
| Tool | `pay_reinstatement_recovery_expenses_82a1a2b9`, a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it |
| What one call does | the borrower pays, from their own funds through a certified payment channel, the recovery expense portion of reinstating their contract and getting their repossessed vehicle back; one settlement of the case's recovery expenses paid by the borrower is recorded, dated today, for the given amount, and the case's posted recovery expenses outstanding fall by that amount, never below 0.00 |
| `recovery_case_id` | the reference number of the borrower's repossession case, as the agent reads it out from the repossession case lookup for the borrower's contract |
| `amount_usd` | the amount the borrower pays toward the case's recovery expenses, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |
| Return | a confirmation string naming the new case activity reference number (a text identifier that begins with "rrxp_"), the case reference number, the amount paid in USD with 2 decimal places, the settlement method paid_by_borrower, the payment date in YYYY-MM-DD form and the case's remaining recovery expenses outstanding in USD with 2 decimal places; a string that begins with "Reinstatement expense payment received" means the payment was recorded |

After the call the borrower sees the payment in the case activity and the reduced outstanding figure on the case.
